verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at the site root and markdown docs pages such as introduction.md that point agents to a docs-specific llms.txt index. Many pages are also served as .md, and the onboarding docs explicitly say to "hand this page to your coding agent" to run setup. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice, and evidence of the docs llms.txt index's completeness (e.g., an llms-full.txt).
